title: Client Mode & Multi-User Authorization

discovery.purpose: Enhanced mDNS scanner with gateway discovery, TXT record parsing (pubkey, version, petname), 5s timeout
integration_points: Phase 1: Uses crypto_domain for pubkey validation
Phase 3: Enhanced from basic mDNS advertising to full discovery

client_domain.purpose: BRC-103 authentication handshake (initial → nonce → sign → verify → session token), client session management
integration_points: Phase 1: Delegates ECDSA signing to crypto_domain/signing.rs
Phase 1: Uses keypair.rs for client identity
Phase 4: SQLite for session persistence (offline support)

auth_users.purpose: Multi-user authorization system with Owner/Member/Guest permission levels, JSON file persistence
integration_points: Phase 2: Integrates with subscription_domain for access gating
Phase 3: Extends config.rs for multi-user persistence

auth_invitations.purpose: Invitation lifecycle FSM (Pending → Accepted/Revoked/Expired), 64-char hex token generation, QR code data backend
integration_points: Phase 1: Uses crypto RNG (rand::thread_rng()) for secure token generation
Phase 4: Backend QR generation for type-safe InvitationData struct

commands_client.purpose: Tauri command handlers for client mode operations (scan, connect, disconnect, status)
integration_points: Frontend: useClientConnection hook
Frontend: GatewayDiscovery component
Frontend: ConnectionStatus component

commands_auth.purpose: Tauri command handlers for user management and invitation operations
key_commands: verify_brc103_signature(challenge: String, signature: String, pubkey: String) -> Result<bool>
integration_points: Frontend: useInvitations hook
Frontend: AccessControl component
Frontend: InvitationManager component

commands_config.purpose: Extended config persistence with mode switching (gateway ↔ client), atomic writes, platform-specific paths
integration_points: Phase 3: Enhanced from basic config to support mode switching
Frontend: useConfig hook
Frontend: ModeSelector component

lib_rs.purpose: Tauri app initialization with 45 total commands (19 new in Phase 4)
registered_commands: Phase 1 (7): generate_keypair, sign_message, verify_signature, get_public_key, derive_child_key, encrypt_message, decrypt_message
Phase 2 (10): start_gateway, stop_gateway, gateway_status, verify_spv_proof, calculate_merkle_root, check_subscription, subscribe, unsubscribe, get_subscription_status, parse_bump
Phase 3 (9): get_config, save_config, show_tray_menu, hide_tray_menu, update_tray_status, send_chat_message, get_chat_history, advertise_mdns, stop_mdns

Phase 4 (19): scan_network, connect_to_gateway, disconnect, get_connection_status, authorize_user, get_authorized_users, list_users, get_user, remove_user, update_user_activity, create_invitation, redeem_invitation, revoke_invitation, list_invitations, check_authorization, verify_brc103_signature, set_mode, generate_qr_data, cleanup_expired_invitations
integration_points: All commands exposed via Tauri IPC bridge
Frontend invokes via window.__TAURI__.invoke()

Activity timestamp (relative time, e.g., '2 hours ago')

ModeSelector.purpose: Gateway vs. Client mode selection screen with explanations

ModeSwitcher.purpose: Runtime mode switching UI in settings panel

useAuthorization.purpose: User authorization management (list users, check permissions, add/remove users)

useNetworkScan.purpose: Network scanning with auto-refresh and timeout management

client.purpose: Client mode type definitions (GatewayInfo, SessionInfo, ConnectionStatus, etc.)

ConnectionStatus { status: 'connected' | 'connecting' | 'disconnected' | 'error', gateway?: GatewayInfo, session?: SessionInfo, error?: string }

key_types: AuthorizedUser { pubkey, petname, permissionLevel, addedAt, lastSeenAt, addedBy }
Invitation { token, createdBy, permissionLevel, createdAt, expiresAt, status: 'Pending' | 'Accepted' | 'Revoked' | 'Expired', redeemedBy?, redeemedAt? }
QRCodeData { version: 1, invitation: Invitation, gatewayUrl: string, gatewayPetname: string }

phase4.purpose: Phase 4-specific IPC request/response type definitions for all 19 commands

deviations.title: Added set_mode command
deviations.rationale: Simplifies mode switching with atomic validation (get → modify → save pattern error-prone)
deviations.impact: +15 LOC in commands/config.rs, cleaner frontend API

deviations.title: QR code backend generation
deviations.rationale: Type-safe QRCodeData struct (version + invitation + gateway + petname) better than frontend string concatenation
deviations.impact: +58 LOC in auth/invitations.rs, prevents QR data format drift

deviations.title: SQLite storage for authorized users (client side)
deviations.rationale: Offline support for client mode (reconnect without re-auth), faster than HTTP refetch on every app launch

integration_points.description: BRC-103 authentication delegates ECDSA signing to crypto_domain/signing.rs
Client identity uses keypair.rs for pubkey derivation
Invitation token generation uses crypto RNG (rand::thread_rng())
Subscription gating checks user permission level before gateway operations
mDNS discovery enhanced with TXT record parsing (pubkey, version, petname)
Config persistence extended for mode switching and client session storage

Performance profiling (QR generation, SQLite query optimization)
